title: Billy Berg's club and who played there
summary: Morgenstern mentions Dickenson's band at Billy Berg's, where Hawkins, Dizzy and Charlie played.

blocks.x: You were like -- say in the first year -- you had your band with Billie Berg's (PHONETIC) and (inaudible) and that's a place that's become famous because Dizzy and Berg played there you know like the first time they did --
Yeah, a lot of guys played there. Hawkins did. I don't know for sure that Louis didn't play there. I'm not sure.
With a big band I guess at that
They didn't have to have too big a band. Too big a band on there -- that wasn't a real big stand.
So it must have been the Allstars on there.
Probably, I don't know for sure whether they played there or not. I know -- I know Hawkins played there and Dizzy, Charlie, and quite a few other guys.
